content_sections.heading: About LUVAS Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Lala Lajpat Rai University of Veterinary and Animal Sciences (LUVAS) is a university in Hisar, Haryana (PIN 125004). The Department of Livestock Production Management in its College of Veterinary Sciences runs the project "Field Progeny Testing programme for Buffalo Improvement (Murrah)". The Principal Investigator is Dr. Dipin Chander Yadav.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: You need one of the following: B.Sc./ 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology from a recognized College/ University OR (i) 10+2 with Science from a school affiliated to / recognized by State or Central Board of School Education, and (ii) Diploma in Veterinary Laboratory Technology (DVLT) or Diploma in Dairy Technology (DIDT) from recognised University/Institute Experience of working with field based research project(s) Knowledge of operating computer and MS office The minimum age is 18 years and the upper age limit is 50 years, as on the last date of application (5 November 2026). The post is in the General category. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, see the official notification. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly emoluments are Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA (As per LUVAS rules). The selected candidate is entitled to TA/DA as per rules. Salary will be paid when the funds arrive from the funding agency. The position is purely contractual and co-terminus with the project. When the project ends, the candidate will be relieved, and the university/department will not be responsible for placing him/her elsewhere in the university. If the work and conduct are not found satisfactory, the services can be terminated at any time, after the person concerned has had a due opportunity of being heard. The services can also be terminated at any time if funds run short. A selected candidate who wants to leave can do so after giving 15 days' notice in writing to the department/university. The selected candidate will not be a regular employee of the university and will not be entitled to CPF/GPF or any other benefit given to regular employees.

content_sections.heading: LUVAS Project Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: Project co-ordination with field A.I workers, Data collection, reports preparation and all other project related activities. Any other work assigned by the PI or the university authorities. The place of working is the Department of Livestock Production Management, COVS, LUVAS, or any other place the Principal Investigator deputes, including the selected project area.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for LUVAS Project Assistant
content_sections.text: Apply on the prescribed proforma (the application form on the last page of the notification). Send it, complete in all respects and with self-attested copies of your documents, to: The Professor and Head, Department of Livestock Production Management, College of Veterinary Sciences, LUVAS, Hisar -125004 (Haryana). You can send it by post, by hand or by email to [email protected] . It must arrive by 5 November 2026, up to 5:00 P.M. Applications that come after this will not be considered for any reason. Application form on the prescribed proforma with a photograph pasted on it Proof of address Proof of educational qualifications Proof of additional qualifications Proof of experience Self-attested copies of all documents Signed declaration on the form that the information is true and correct The form also asks for your name, the position applied for, your father's/husband's name, your date of birth and age, gender, mobile number, Aadhar number and email ID.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in LUVAS Recruitment 2026 for Project Assistant?
faq.answer: There is 1 Project Assistant post, in the General category, under the Field Progeny Testing programme for Buffalo Improvement (Murrah).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the LUVAS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Professor and Head, Department of Livestock Production Management, LUVAS, Hisar, by 5 November 2026, up to 5:00 P.M. Applications received later will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the LUVAS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: You need a B.Sc./ 3 years Diploma in Engineering & Technology from a recognized College/ University. The alternative is 10+2 with Science plus a Diploma in Veterinary Laboratory Technology (DVLT) or Diploma in Dairy Technology (DIDT) from a recognised University/Institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the LUVAS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the upper age limit is 50 years, as on the last date of application (5 November 2026).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a LUVAS Project Assistant?
faq.answer: The monthly emoluments are Rs. 20,000/- plus HRA (As per LUVAS rules). Salary is paid when funds are received from the funding agency.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA or any allowance paid on top of the Rs. 20,000 pay?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA is paid as per LUVAS rules on top of Rs. 20,000/-, and the selected candidate is entitled to TA/DA as per rules. CPF/GPF and other benefits for regular employees are not given.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the LUVAS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Fill in the prescribed proforma and attach self-attested copies of your documents. Send it to the Professor and Head, Department of Livestock Production Management, College of Veterinary Sciences, LUVAS, Hisar -125004 (Haryana), by post, by hand or by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. Is the LUVAS Project Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely contractual and co-terminus with the project. The selected candidate will not be a regular employee of the university.

faq.question: Q9. What experience or skills are desirable for the LUVAS Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The desirable qualifications are experience of working with field based research project(s) and knowledge of operating computer and MS office.

faq.question: Q10. What must the selected LUVAS Project Assistant do before joining?
faq.answer: The selected candidate must produce a certificate of medical fitness from the CMO of the University and sign an agreement on Rs.10/- non-judicial stamp paper. He/she must also report for duty within 10 days of the order being issued.
